name: More Island Events
description: Adds new island events, written by the owner, to the ones the game draws from (more come in later versions). Four here: The Aspiring Adventurer -- a villager who loves to explore sees something glinting off the safe path. "Go investigate!" finds a pile of dirt, a stack of meat (food) or a golden chest of artifacts (tech points); half the time the adventurer gets home (with the find, or with a friend's help), half the time a trap leads to death (a grave) or a disappearance (no grave). "Stay on the safe path" brings them home 9 times in 10; otherwise they are lost: hurt, healed or disabled, a skilled survivalist, killed, gone, or they join another tribe. The event is one more of the game's two-choice island events (family A) with its own slot in the draw, 1 in 23 a draw like each of them (the draw is one wider for The Climb), never the village's first island event; it needs two villagers of 14 or more who are not nursing a baby and not an Esteemed Elder's totem statue, and the adventurer and the friend who may come to help are drawn from them. The reward is a random amount from the smallest to the largest food or tech-point gain of the game's own island events (100 to 1,500 food for the meat, 500 to 3,000 tech points for the chest) times the game's own factor for its two-choice events (1 up to 25 villagers, 2 up to 50, 3 above). Deaths are the game's own ("Unknown causes", with a grave); a disappearance is logged as one in the Deaths log. The popups show the owner's text in pages that fit the screen (OK shows the next) -- with Scrolling Popups installed, one scrolling popup for the question and one for each answer's result; the effects wait for the page that tells them, and the Island Events log keeps one entry for each event. And The Climb (The Lost Children only): a villager of 18 or more who is at least a Trainee in Research (20 or more) wants to climb the Great Falls. "Go with the plan": half the time they fall and die (a grave); half the time they reach the top -- their Research becomes the game's maximum (100), the village gains a large tech award (twice a normal one: 1,000 to 6,000 tech points, then the game's own factor) and everyone celebrates. "Follow the scientists' advice": +10 to 20 Research (at most 100). One villager who may go is enough; it has its own slot among the two-choice events. And The Remembrance Ceremony and The Rumblings (all five games; one popup each, OK only). The Remembrance Ceremony needs at least one grave: everyone joins in -- children, nursing mothers and fathers, everyone -- each at the memorial, "Honoring the Dead" or "Reflecting" (half the time each), and the feast quietly uses 10 food for every villager (never below 0). The Rumblings needs every puzzle solved and a finished hut: an earthquake damages each of the three population huts (the Lovely Hut, the Hospital and the Sewing Hut are puzzles and are never damaged) one time in four (at least one always), each losing 10 to 100% of its building work; the builders must build it again (at 100% it is unbuilt again, as in a new village). Nobody is hurt; a village over its limit keeps everyone and has no new births until it is rebuilt. Each has its own share of the draw and can come again. With Story / Cheat Upgrades, Pick Island Event lists each of these events and picks one whenever its own requirements hold (otherwise it says what the event needs). Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Needs no other patch.** **Unverified in play: the event has not been seen in a running game** (emulated on the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP More Island Events.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; nothing is saved by it.
behavior_changes: The event is one more of the game's two-choice island events (family A) with its own slot in the draw, 1 in 23 a draw like each of them (the draw is one wider for The Climb), never the village's first island event. It can happen only while at least two villagers may go: 14 or more (280 age units), alive and present, not carrying a baby, and not an Esteemed Elder's totem statue; the adventurer and the friend of ending A8 are drawn from them, the friend never the adventurer.

Choice A, "Go investigate!": the find 50% a pile of dirt, 25% meat (a food award: 100 to 1,500 food), 25% a golden chest (a tech award: 500 to 3,000 tech points); then 50% a surviving ending (after the dirt A7 or A9; after a find A1, A5 or A8, which give the reward) and 50% a deadly one (A2 and A4 die, the game's own death with cause -1 and a grave; A3 and A6 disappear, no body), each equally likely within its half.

Choice B, "Stay on the safe path": 90% home safe; 10% lost, then 1 in 6 each: the healers (1 in 3 each: dies; a full recovery; health set to 10-50 and running disliked), joins another tribe (gone for good, no grave), a survivalist (+20 to 30 in Farming, Building, Research or Healing, at most 100), dies under a fallen tree, dies at the bottom of a cliff, disappears.

The reward is drawn, each amount equally likely, from the game's smallest to its largest stock island-event gain of that kind (src/vv_aspiring_adventurer.py AWARD_RANGES), and goes through the game's own food or tech writer, times the game's own factor for its two-choice events (1 up to 25 villagers, 2 up to 50, 3 above). The effects wait for their own page (the page that ends the ending's text), and the event writes its own one Island Events log entry; a disappearance is told to the Cause of Death companion (VvfpCauseVanishedBy), so its Deaths log records it as one.

The owner's words, by translation key (the event's popup shows the player's language when a translation has them), are laid out in pages that fit the game's popup -- whole paragraphs, else whole sentences -- each shown in turn with OK.

The Climb (The Lost Children): its own slot in family A's draw, 22 of rand(23) (The Aspiring Adventurer 21; each 1 in 23 a draw, like each stock event), kept only while a villager who may go on The Aspiring Adventurer is 18 or more (360 age units) with Research +0x7F4 of 20 or more (the game's own "Trainee" level, 0x429C3D); the villager is drawn among them. "Go with the plan": 50% the fall (health 0: a body and a grave), 50% the summit (Research set to the game's cap 100, 0x4212F4; a large tech award, twice a normal one, through the family-A tech writer 0x426290 after the two-choice factor 0x41F720; the game's own village celebration 0x45D7D0 with Old Friends' place 0x18). "Follow the scientists' advice": +10 to 20 Research, at most 100. The effects wait for their own page: they are made when the page that ends the ending's text is shown, and the event writes its own one Island Events log entry (VvfpIslandEventsGraphBegin / End / Write).

The Remembrance Ceremony and The Rumblings (ceremony_core.inc, ceremony_games.inc): each its own case in the single-result events' draw (rand(28) one wider for each of the two that can happen), through two sites of its own; the game's own single-result popup shows the owner's words, the effects are made as it is built, with the event's one Island Events log entry. The Remembrance Ceremony: needs at least one grave (the game's own grave count); every living, present villager is started on its own through the game's own stop and action starter, as its Day of Honor starts each one (so no group filter leaves anyone out), at the memorial, "Honoring the Dead" or "Reflecting" (half the time each); the feast uses 10 food for every villager the game counts, never below 0 (Blessings Day's own rule). The Rumblings: needs every puzzle of the game's Puzzles screen solved and one of the three population huts (the Lovely Hut, the Hospital and the Sewing Hut are puzzles and are never damaged) finished; each finished one rand(100) < 25 (none: one of them at random), each losing 10 + rand(91) percent of its building work, written as the states the game's own construction passes through (at 100% the new village's state).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes each site at run time, only after verifying every site's stock bytes (all of them, or none); without it the event does not exist.
Every stock event, its odds, the island-event timer and counting, the rescue rules and Custom Island Events are unchanged; nothing is saved by the companion.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the draw, the popup pages, both choices' effects and the install with every other patch emulated on the stock executable in tests/test_aspiring_adventurer.py (The Climb: who may climb, both answers, both climbs, every effect and its pages, in tests/test_the_climb.py); The Remembrance Ceremony and The Rumblings: the conditions, the draw, everyone sent and where, the feast, the damage and its states, the log entry and the words, in tests/test_ceremony_and_rumblings.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
